title: In the Public Interest
question: What could not be reported in the official files?

meanings.meaning: 斯堪的纳维亚的；北欧国家的
meanings.usage: 用于描述北欧地区的国家或文化
形容政策、制度等具有先进性和人性化
强调事物逐渐演变发展的过程

meanings.meaning: 高压的；专横的；盛气凌人的
meanings.usage: 形容滥用权力、傲慢的行为方式
形容在工作或职责上不能胜任的人
表示采取措施保护某人或某物免受伤害
指个人对不公正待遇的申诉或投诉

meanings.meaning: 巡视官；调查官；申诉专员
meanings.usage: 指负责调查公民对政府官员投诉的官员

meanings.meaning: 过于热心的；过分积极的
meanings.usage: 形容做事过于热情而可能出错
指权威人士对下属的正式责备
指通过调查或研究来发现事实真相
形容对某事物持有不公平的先入为主的看法
指通过法律程序对某人提起诉讼
形容行动迅速、毫不拖延的
指正式向有关部门提交投诉或申诉

phrases.usage: 为了公共利益；符合公众利益

examples.en: The minister acted in the public interest.
examples.zh: 部长为了公共利益行事。

phrases.usage: 逐步形成一套优秀的体制

examples.en: Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting citizens.
examples.zh: 瑞典逐步形成了一套优秀的保护公民的体制。

examples.en: The system protects the individual citizen from incompetent officials.
examples.zh: 该体制保护个人公民免受不称职官员的侵害。

phrases.usage: 保护...的利益；维护...的利益

examples.en: The scheme was introduced to safeguard the interest of the individual.
examples.zh: 该方案的出台是为了保护个人的利益。

examples.en: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
examples.zh: 巡视官不受政治压力的影响。

phrases.usage: 代表某人采取行动；代理

examples.en: If a citizen's complaint is justified, the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
examples.zh: 如果公民的投诉是合理的，巡视官将代表他采取行动。

examples.en: If any further complaints are lodged against him, he will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 如果再有人对他提出投诉，他将受到起诉。

examples.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action put an end to an unpleasant practice.
examples.zh: 巡视官的迅速行动结束了一种不良做法。

examples.en: A policeman had dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
examples.zh: 一名警察多次粗暴对待外国人。

phrases.usage: 公开接受公众检查；可供公众查阅

examples.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
examples.zh: 巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

sentences.en: The Scandinavian countries are much admired all over the world for their enlightened social policies.
sentences.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚国家以其开明的社会政策而受到全世界的普遍赞扬。

sentences.en: Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting the individual citizen from high-handed or incompetent public officers.
sentences.zh: 瑞典已逐步建立起一套完善的制度来保护公民不受专横或渎职的政府官员的侵害。

sentences.en: The system has worked so well, that it has been adopted in other countries too.
sentences.zh: 这套制度非常行之有效，以至于其他国家也采用了它。

sentences.en: The Swedes were the first to recognize that public officials like civil servants,
sentences.zh: 瑞典人最先认识到，政府官员，如公务员、

sentences.en: police officers, health inspectors or tax-collectors can make mistakes or act over-zealously in the belief that they are serving the public.
sentences.zh: 警官、卫生检察员或税务官，都可能犯错误，或者相信他们在为公众服务而工作过分热心。

sentences.en: As long ago as 1809, the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme to safeguard the interest of the individual.
sentences.zh: 早在1809年，瑞典议会就制定了一项保护个人利益的计划。

sentences.en: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person who is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State.
sentences.zh: 一个由所有政党组成的议会委员会任命一位有资格调查个人对国家不满的投诉的人。

sentences.en: The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman', but the Swedes commonly refer to him as the 'J.O.' or 'Ombudsman'.
sentences.zh: 这个人的官方头衔是“司法特派员”，但瑞典人通常称他为“J.O.”或“特派员”。

sentences.en: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
sentences.zh: 监察官不受政治压力。

sentences.en: He investigates complaints large and small that come to him from all levels of society.
sentences.zh: 他调查来自社会各阶层的大小投诉。

sentences.en: As complaints must be made in writing, the Ombudsman receives an average of 1, 200 letters a year.
sentences.zh: 由于投诉必须以书面形式提出，监察官平均每年收到1200封信。

sentences.en: He has eight lawyer assistants to help him and he examines every single letter in detail.
sentences.zh: 他有八名律师助理帮助他，他会详细审查每一封信。

sentences.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
sentences.zh: 监察官的工作毫无秘密可言，因为他的信件都公开供公众查阅。

sentences.en: If a citizen's complaint is justified the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 如果公民的投诉是有根据的，监察官将代表他采取行动。

sentences.en: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint.
sentences.zh: 他采取的行动因投诉的性质而异。

sentences.en: He may gently reprimand an official or even suggest to parliament that a law be altered.
sentences.zh: 他可以温和地训斥一名官员，甚至向议会建议修改法律。

sentences.en: The following case is a typical example of the Ombudsman's work.
sentences.zh: 下面这个案例是监察官工作的典型例子。

sentences.en: A foreigner living in a Swedish village wrote to the Ombudsman complaining that he had been ill-treated by the police,
sentences.zh: 一个住在瑞典乡村的外国人写信给监察官，抱怨他受到警察的虐待，

sentences.en: simply because he was a foreigner.
sentences.zh: 只因为他是个外国人。

sentences.en: The Ombudsman immediately wrote to the Chief of Police in the district asking him to send a record of the case.
sentences.zh: 监察官立即写信给该地区的警察局长，要求他寄送案件记录。

sentences.en: There was nothing in the record to show that the foreigner's complaint was justified
sentences.zh: 记录中没有任何内容表明该外国人的投诉是有根据的，

sentences.en: and the Chief of Police strongly denied the accusation.
sentences.zh: 警察局长也强烈否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: It was impossible for the Ombudsman to take action,
sentences.zh: 监察官无法采取行动，

sentences.en: but when he received a similar complaint from another foreigner in the same village,
sentences.zh: 但当他收到同一村庄另一名外国人的类似投诉时，

sentences.en: he immediately sent one of his lawyers to investigate the matter.
sentences.zh: 他立即派他的一名律师去调查此事。

sentences.en: The lawyer ascertained that a policeman had indeed dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
sentences.zh: 律师证实，一名警察确实曾多次粗暴对待外国人。

sentences.en: The fact that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners could not be recorded in the official files.
sentences.zh: 这名警察对外国人有偏见的事实，无法记录在官方档案中。

sentences.en: It was only possible for the Ombudsman to find this out by sending one of his representatives to check the facts.
sentences.zh: 监察官只有通过派他的一名代表去核实事实才能发现这一点。

sentences.en: The policeman in question was severely reprimanded
sentences.zh: 这名警察受到了严厉的训斥，

sentences.en: and was informed that if any further complaints were lodged against him, he would be prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 并被告知，如果再有针对他的投诉，他将被起诉。

sentences.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action at once put an end to an unpleasant practice which might have gone unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 监察官的迅速行动立即制止了一种可能被忽视的不愉快的做法。

exercises.prompt: “so后面接形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句，表示'如此...以至于...'。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
options: not only位于句首的部分倒装结构
make it + 形容词 + for sb. to do sth.
exercises.explain: so...that 结果状语从句：so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句：用于表达某种程度导致的结果。在文中说明瑞典体制运行良好以至于被其他国家采纳。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.definition: 现在完成时被动语态表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或动作持续到现在，且主语是动作的承受者。
grammar.usage: 用于描述某个动作或过程的结果，强调其对现在的影响。文中描述瑞典的体制被其他国家采用这一结果。

examples.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
examples.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。

examples.en: The Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme in 1809.
examples.zh: 瑞典议会在1809年推出了一个方案。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语 (Past Participle as Attribute)
grammar.definition: 过去分词作定语时，放在被修饰的名词之前或之后，表示被动和完成的意义。
grammar.structure: 名词 + 过去分词 / 过去分词 + 名词
grammar.usage: 用于简化定语从句，使句子更加简洁。常用于正式书面语中。

examples.en: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person.
examples.zh: 一个代表所有政党的议会委员会任命一人。

examples.en: The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman'.
examples.zh: 这个人的官方头衔是'司法特派员'。

grammar.title: so...that 结果状语从句
grammar.definition: so后面接形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句，表示'如此...以至于...'。
grammar.structure: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.usage: 用于表达某种程度导致的结果。在文中说明瑞典体制运行良好以至于被其他国家采纳。

examples.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
examples.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了。

examples.en: He is so busy that he cannot come.
examples.zh: 他太忙了，不能来。

patterns.pattern: The system has worked so well that...

original.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
original.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。

examples.en: The policy has worked so well that it has become a model for other countries.
examples.zh: 这项政策运行良好，已成为其他国家的典范。

examples.en: The new teaching method has worked so well that it has been推广 in all schools.
examples.zh: 新的教学方法效果良好，已在所有学校推广。

patterns.pattern: As long ago as + 年份, ... + 一般过去时

original.en: As long ago as 1809, the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme to safeguard the interest of the individual.
original.zh: 早在1809年，瑞典议会就推出了保护个人利益的方案。

examples.en: As long ago as 1990, China began its reform and opening-up policy.
examples.zh: 早在1990年，中国就开始了改革开放政策。

examples.en: As long ago as 1950, scientists discovered this phenomenon.
examples.zh: 早在1950年，科学家们就发现了这一现象。

original.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
original.zh: 巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

examples.en: There is nothing secretive about the government's decision.
examples.zh: 政府的这项决定没有任何秘密。

examples.en: There is nothing secretive about our company's financial report.
examples.zh: 我们公司的财务报告没有任何隐瞒。

patterns.pattern: The action he takes varies according to...

original.en: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint.
original.zh: 他采取的行动因投诉的性质而异。

examples.en: The punishment varies according to the seriousness of the crime.
examples.zh: 惩罚的轻重取决于犯罪的严重程度。

examples.en: The salary varies according to qualifications and experience.
examples.zh: 工资根据资历和经验而有所不同。
